{{Quote|We don't serve your type either.''"<br />"''What type are you referring to?''"<br />"''Conduit worms.''"<br />"''I beg your pardon, I am a Zilkin!|[[Borkus/Legends|Borkus]] ejects [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] from [[Power Sliders/Legends|his diner]]|<ref name="Missing in Action">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>}}
'''Zilkins''' were a small, [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

==Biology==
They were diminutive in size and had stalk [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They were green with darker spots and had blue eyes. The hands and feet of a Zilkin were large in proportion to their arms and legs. They had three bulbous fingers and an opposable thumb on their hands, and three toes on their feet.

Zilkins had large bulbs of skin underneath their chin that puffed out slightly when they talked.

==History==
[[File:ColonelGascon-SW.png|thumb|left|150px|Meebur Gascon]]
At around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the commanding officer of [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]], was a member of this species. He was a strategic [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] and had served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] since the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]].

Later in the war, Gascon was assigned a squad of droids and was part of a secret mission to steal an [[Encryption module/Legends|Encryption module]] from the Separatists.

This eventually led to him encountering a field of comets, getting stranded on the strange world of [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]], discovering and returning the memory of the [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]], and being part of the destruction of a hijacked [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] full of [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]] over [[Carida/Legends|Carida]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Zilkins first appeared in ''[[Secret Weapons]]'', the tenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]]. They were based on a drawing of an early version of [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], by [[Terryl Whitlatch]].
